_source: Texas entries are real, named facts from 2025-2026 developments cited in the project research brief (SB6, the Aug 2026 grid-tied interconnection pause, Fort Worth/San Antonio application pauses, Hill County's moratorium, Hood County's two rejections, plus informational 'notable' context on Ector/Harris/Collin/Nueces). Entries for every other state are a placeholder — no state-specific regulatory dataset is modeled yet for them. See README for how to extend this per state.

TX.gridTiedPauseNote: Gov. Abbott's Aug 2026 order pauses new grid-tied interconnections pending audit — this cap lifts once the audit clears, or switch to self-generated.

Tarrant.reason: Fort Worth has paused new datacenter applications.

Hood.reason: Hood County rejected two prior siting attempts.

Hill.reason: Hill County passed a moratorium on new datacenter development.

Travis.reason: Residential buffer zone — too close to dense residential development.

Hays.reason: Edwards Aquifer recharge zone — protected from new impervious development.

Bexar.reason: San Antonio has paused new datacenter applications.

Ector.reason: Dense transmission buildout serving Permian Basin oil & gas load.

Harris.reason: Ship-channel industrial corridor — heavy existing interconnection capacity.

Nueces.reason: South Texas energy corridor, strong wind generation nearby.
